name: Color Channel Mixer
description: Mixes the red, green, blue and alpha channels with a 4x4 matrix.

params.name: rr
params.description: Gain of the red channel in the red channel

params.name: rg
params.description: Gain of the green channel in the red channel

params.name: rb
params.description: Gain of the blue channel in the red channel

params.name: ra
params.description: Gain of the alpha channel in the red channel

params.name: gr
params.description: Gain of the red channel in the green channel

params.name: gg
params.description: Gain of the green channel in the green channel

params.name: gb
params.description: Gain of the blue channel in the green channel

params.name: ga
params.description: Gain of the alpha channel in the green channel

params.name: br
params.description: Gain of the red channel in the blue channel

params.name: bg
params.description: Gain of the green channel in the blue channel

params.name: bb
params.description: Gain of the blue channel in the blue channel

params.name: ba
params.description: Gain of the alpha channel in the blue channel

params.name: ar
params.description: Gain of the red channel in the alpha channel

params.name: ag
params.description: Gain of the green channel in the alpha channel

params.name: ab
params.description: Gain of the blue channel in the alpha channel

params.name: aa
params.description: Gain of the alpha channel in the alpha channel

params.name: pc
params.description: Preserve color mode: 0 = none, 1 = lum, 2 = max, 3 = avg, 4 = sum, 5 = nrm, 6 = pwr
